name: neumorph-eyebrow
title: Neumorph Eyebrow
description: A short, pill-shaped label with a thin border and a soft pressed-in shadow, made to sit above a section heading. It comes in cream, pale blue and pale green.
use: You need a short pre-heading label that reads as a soft physical tag rather than a flat chip.
avoid: The text runs past a couple of words: the pill has a fixed height and will not wrap or grow.
a11y: Plain text in a div reads correctly, but it carries no status or badge role for assistive tech. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Small fully rounded pills with a hairline border and a soft top-lit glow that makes them look pressed out of the surface. The default is cream with near-black text; the other two tint both fill and text pale blue or pale green.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. Each pill simply shows its short piece of text, and hovering or clicking does nothing.
customise: intent picks cream, blue or green, className adds classes, and children supply the text. All colours live in the variant map and need a source edit.
weight: light: Three small divs and a class map; nothing animates, loads or listens.
